newsitem.title: USA: Uruguay seeks one mln barrels of crude for April.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay seeks one mln barrels of crude for April.

text.p: Uruguay's state-owned oil refiner ANCAP is seeking one million barrels of crude for delivery April 5-10 to the Jose Ignacio terminal, trade sources said.
The tender will be awarded on Wednesday, sources said.
ANCAP had temporarily suspended its regular crude deliveries during a planned shutdown of the 34,600 barrels per day (bpd) La Teja refinery now underway.
The refinery is scheduled to come back on line around the end of February once the catalytic cracker is replaced, sources said.
During the shutdown, ANCAP is importing fuel oil, gas oil and gasoline.
In its last crude tender in November, Uruguay purchased Santa Cruz and Oriente cargoes.
